title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Pomelo Soda
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Pomelo Soda Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This zesty and uplifting option includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a uniquely citrusy soda flavour. Pomelo Soda combines the tangy, slightly sweet citrus notes of Pomelo — a mellow cousin of Grapefruit — with a sparkling soda twist for a bright and effervescent vape. Light and refreshing, it’s perfect for vapers who enjoy unusual citrus flavours with a fizzy finish. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour.
